description: Single-W StyleGAN2 path-length penalty: sample an unnormalized image-space Gaussian direction, compute the latent Jacobian-vector product as a gradient, then square its deviation from the caller-supplied target scale per sample (Karras et al., §3.2 Eq. (4), §4.2 Eq. (5), Appendix C Eq. (6); src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-50). The caller maintains the target-scale EMA and applies resolution weighting and lazy-regularization scheduling.

examples.title: Train a tiny generator with path-length regularization

name: StyleGAN2 path-length regularization

parameters.additional parameters: target_scale, weight, and noise are accepted; unsupported keys raise ValueError. EMA decay pl_decay and lazy interval are maintained and applied by the caller, not by this stateless loss
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because generated images and latent styles are continuous tensors
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point generated images with shape [B,C,H,W] (or another nonempty batch-first image-space tensor), requiring gradients
parameters.noise: optional finite standard-normal image-space direction with the same shape, dtype, and device as logits_or_prediction; None samples an unnormalized direction (default None)
parameters.reduction: none returns squared penalties per sample, mean averages samples, or sum totals samples (default mean)
parameters.target_scale: finite nonnegative detached scalar a, supplied from caller-maintained EMA initialized at 0 with decay beta_pl=0.99 (default 0)
parameters.targets: finite floating-point differentiable single-W latent vectors shaped [B,L], with positive dimensions and the same batch, dtype, and device as logits_or_prediction
parameters.weight: finite nonnegative scalar multiplier; default 1 for Eq. (6), while callers may pass resolution weight gamma_pl and lazy interval multiplier k (default 1)
